notes: Choose your main archetype (for example Trapper or Riftwalker): the ability tree keeps more of its abilities than any other archetype's, borrowing from other paths only where they help. Or leave an archetype out completely ("anything but Battle Monk"). Both are in the form and the bot understands them. Arrow Shield is no longer counted as damage per second, because its arrows only hit enemies that come close to you (it still counts in the one-time combo).
